description: Land Title Settlement Department - Karandagollawatta, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala  District - Cad.  Map No. 420045
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names, identity card numbers, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for specific land parcels in various locations.
